First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.

Slow, casual. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @RockHillBikeClub the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rock Hill Bicycle Club Slow Spokes group ride

Rock Hill Bicycle Club Slow Spokes is a road and social group ride in Rock Hill, SC. It rolls every Tuesday at 9:00 am from Cherry Park (far side of the parking lot).

A shorter, slower Tuesday morning ride from Cherry Park. The club lists it as casual, beginner-friendly and no-drop. Helmet required. All are welcome.
